description_ko:
(Low Pressure Melamine)
LPM is an eco-friendly surface material created by impregnating decorative paper with melamine and urea resins. Using only heat and pressure, it thermally fuses directly onto substrates like MDF, HDF, and PB-eliminating the need for extra adhesives.
Key Strengths of the Product
Various Design Expressions
Available in glossy, matte, semi-gloss, embossed, logo patterns, etc.
→ Enables realistic and three-dimensional surface textu
Excellent Durability
Scratch resistance, abrasion resistance, heat resistance, acid resistance, and water resistance.
→ Strong surface performance against external environments.
Eco-Friendly Material
Blocks harmful formaldehyde emissions from the board.
→ Safe for both humans and the environment.
Cost Competitiveness
Maintains functionality and quality.
→ More economical compared to alternative materials.
PRODUCT LINEUP
We offers a wide range of high-performance LPM products optimized for various usage environments, from standard to specialized types, providing customized solutions for high-end furniture and interior markets.
Standard LPM
- Basic LPM for furniture and interior applications
- Decorative paper impregnated with thermosetting resin and coated
- Realistic and embossed texture using press plates
- Approximately 50 design patterns available
LPM Special
- Coating LPM
- Flame-Retardant LPM
- Hi-Flex Low-Banding LPM
- T-White LPM
- Inert Coating LPM
T-White LPM
Excellent opacity (hiding power).
By adding special additives to standard white paper, T-White delivers excellent opacity in 100 gsm and 150 gsm grades.
High gloss and high opacity for premium markets.
Coating LPM
Functional LPM that allows direct painting.
Surface developed for Poly coating.
High gloss achievable with a single coating, minimal odor.
Compatible with additional processes (High Gloss, UV, etc.).
Reduces processing steps and costs.
Hi-Flex Low-Banding LPM
High elasticity with minimal warping.
Reduces bending when pressed on one side.
Compatible with various backing materials (PET, UV, etc.).
Flame-Retardant LPM
Meets fire safety standards.
Flame-retardant solution added during production.
Suitable for public and commercial spaces.
Inert Coating LPM
Additional coating applied on standard LPM surface.
Uses eco-friendly coatings.
Anti-fingerprint and high-gloss finish.
Self-healing function for scratch recovery.

Apply:

Base Paper / Decorative Paper Impregnated with Primary Aqueous Acrylic Resin and Coated with Water-Based Lacquer
Post Foil
General paper (60–100 gsm, approximately 3,000 designs from imported paper and Korean manufacturers) is impregnated with aqueous acrylic resin and then coated with water-based lacquer on the surface.
Super Foil
A special water-soluble resin is used during the impregnation process of general paper (60–100 gsm, approximately 3,000 designs from imported paper and Korean manufacturers) to improve adhesion, tensile strength, and surface properties.
UV Foil
Apply: Door, Louver, ETC
